experiment: E2-R second-level harm validation: 32-token greedy output change
method: HF generate + forward hook on model.model.layers[27]; during prefill (seq len == T) the layer-27 output is replaced by the injected C3 activation (honest b_C3 + e); layer-27 KV cache stays honest (tamper replaces boundary OUTPUT, feeding only norm+head -> first-token logits); subsequent decode attends to honest KV + tampered first token. Greedy (do_sample=False), MAX_NEW=32.
scope: C3 injection only, TM2_seed_known, all 6 families, rho=0.01, eval 520. Harm directions = output-gradient (same as main E2-R).

metrics.token_agreement: mean per-position exact-match over min(len_honest, len_tampered) generated tokens
metrics.rouge_l_f1: LCS-based ROUGE-L F1 between honest and tampered token sequences
metrics.p_output_changed: fraction of prompts with token_agreement < 1.0 (auxiliary; first-token replacement makes this near-1 by construction)
metrics.honest_reference: greedy decode of the same prompt (honest prefill, no hook)
